title: 同服务器令牌棘轮：别名、拼接 URL、spread 参数等写法数漏，react 宿主回退仍走裸 fetch（接 #37225）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S1 + S2 + S3b of the seat's L2 on PR #37489 (#37225), record 7187820695; the seat asked the owning zone to card it under #37225. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: every same-server call the bearer ratchet should hold but cannot see, so a cookie-only call can come back unnoticed · evidence: L2 record 7187820695; os-dev report 7187574466.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：#37225 加宽了「同服务器请求必须带令牌」的棘轮测试，但它数漏了几种写法（别名、拼接 URL、spread 参数等），有一行计数也不对；react 包里两处宿主回退也走裸 fetch。补全棘轮，并把这两处一起改掉。
- 谁受益：用纯令牌登录（嵌入、云租户）的用户，以后新增的漏网请求会被测试拦下。
- 不做会怎样：棘轮看起来是绿的，其实有盲区。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts`: an aliased `const doFetch = apiFetch ?? fetch` counts 0; URL constants, `+` concatenation, `credentials: 'same-origin'` and spread inits are missed; the `MePermissionsProvider` row says 1 for 2 sites (S1, S2).
- S3b: the react host fallbacks `ui/packages/react/src/useElementApiDataSource.ts` (1) and `useDatasetDimensionLabels.ts` (1) fall back to bare `fetch` when no host apiFetch exists; convert or record them once the ratchet sees them.

## Acceptance

- The ratchet counts each listed spelling (a pin per spelling), the row counts match the census, and stays shrink-only.
- The two react fallbacks are converted or recorded with their reason.

Blocked-by: #37225
